title: DarkerOakWood
description: Supports 1.21.8 soon We Have A Discord Server Where U Can Suggest More Mods,Resource Packs.Join Now
body:
Bring a darker, more atmospheric touch to Minecraft with this simple tweak.
This pack replaces the vanilla oak wood with a much darker, moodier texture – perfect for builders who want a deeper, fantasy or gothic vibe without losing the vanilla feel.

✔ Vanilla-like style

✔ Works with 1.20.x and 1.21.x

✔ 16x resolution (lightweight, no performance loss)

Ideal for survival builds, medieval castles, or anyone who’s tired of the bright vanilla oak.
